title: JSFL: library.getItemProperty and setItemProperty missing
description: In packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts, the JsflLibrary interface (lines 854-880) lacks getItemProperty() and setItemProperty() methods. Flash 8 supports: lib.getItemProperty('MySymbol', 'linkageIdentifier') and lib.setItemProperty('MySymbol', 'linkageIdentifier', 'myId'). Fix: add both methods to JsflLibrary interface and makeLibraryProxy implementation. getItemProperty(name, prop): looks up library item by name, returns the requested property (support: 'linkageIdentifier', 'exportForActionScript', 'exportInFirstFrame', 'symbolType', 'className', 'name'). setItemProperty(name, prop, value): looks up library item by name, validates it's a symbol, and delegates to setSymbolLinkage() from @flash/core for linkage fields. Follow the pattern used by addItemToDocument for library lookup. Both methods should warn and return undefined/void if the item is not found.
